text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the final day of summer camp, and we're scheduled to return to the academy after lunch.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go get dessert! Anybody else want some too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Around the Table
text_block_list.text: Wow, thanks a lot! Yes please, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Mont Blanc.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? What was that, McQueen? Oho?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Are you a big fan of today's dessert? I bet you'd like to have my Mont Blanc, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What?! I-I couldn't do that! I'm refraining from such indulgences at present!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To claim the shield in the autumn Tenno Sho, some sacrifices are necessary!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: To be able to resist something you love like that, your self-control is amazing, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's because McQueen believes it's the Mejiro family's responsibility to win the shield.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You know… I've been thinking about something ever since the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Watching you Mejiro princesses has made me realize how incredible you all are. You've earned my respect.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Say what now?! Me, a "princess"?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. There's something noble about your strength… Or maybe it's that you grow stronger for the sake of others.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You never shy away from expectations, and your efforts inspire all those around you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to find the strength to shoulder the hopes of everyone who supports me, too. I'd love it if I could be more like you two.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, so that's what you meant! Haha. Well, the thing is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're not a Mejiro, Ines—you're you. So there's no need for you to carry that kind of burden, is there?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You saying I can't do it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, no! That's not what I meant! Hmm… How do I put it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: As long as you follow the path that's laid out in front of you, we'll be able to envision our own dreams through you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I could picture my dream so vividly when I watched you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …You said something similar to me during the Derby, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha, so you noticed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's what I believe, anyway. You have a different kind of strength to my own, and I found solace in that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ack! Wh-what am I blabbering on about?! That was really corny, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, why are you acting all embarrassed? I thought that was a really nice thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahem… Anyway, if you want my advice, then I think you should discuss it directly with your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …With my trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I mean, your trainer is your closest fan, after all. I'm sure that's where your answer's been hiding all along!
